value: /sorted, from Akien's gate design of 2026-08-11

Make a GATE a thing. Every gate in the system becomes a named, instantiated class holding a nest of declared sieves, carrying its own probes, and reporting each transition to the harbor master — so all gates run on common code with per-gate configuration, and what a gate has learned becomes readable rather than stranded in a Python literal.

value.akiens_words: Akien, 2026-08-11, mid-turn: 'what this component has learned is immediately measurable. :) a side win!'
value.the_mechanism: Three layers. SEED — git-JSON in class-space beside the gate, which is what regrows a gate on a bare machine. LIVING — the graph tree node under the gate's runtime folder, moved only by installation. RECONCILIATION — stamps across the pair. The SEED-VERSUS-LIVING DELTA is the learning, and it is a diff, which is to say an instrument.
value.the_negative_result_counts_too: If every gate reports delta=NONE after the system has run a full pass of ordinary work, the founding claim is FALSIFIED. That finding is worth more than a green and must not be reported as 'not yet'.
value.what_it_answers: I-learns-its-gates carries a wrong-intent falsifier written 2026-07-16: 'confidences never move — then it is not learning gates, only executing fixed ones, and the founding claim is false.' It has been UNMEASURABLE for the whole time it has existed, because each dial exists exactly once, as a Python literal, and a literal has no BEFORE.

value: (a) A gate consults an ORACLE at fire time. build_inspector's charter: 'a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate', and 'a learning lands here only by INSTALLATION — evidence-provenanced, ratified, versioned — never mid-fire', because replayability (same input + same revision = same verdict) is what lets a verdict be permanent in a record of truth (Law 7).
(b) The seed and the living value NEVER diverge across real use — then nothing is being learned and this is configuration theatre.

(c) The two stamped artifacts never disagree (the reconciliation is ceremony) or always disagree (it is noise, and noise gets trained away while still looking like coverage). The honest signal is rare and true.

(d) The harbor master starts KEEPING what it is told rather than being told and pointing back — the register stops being an index and becomes a rival record. Forbidden by ruling 2026-08-10-the-ticket-owns-the-refusal.

First-cut names with their whys; each files as its own ticket when taken up, and children prove before parents. The real decomposition is /chart's decompose stage against a measured survey — settling it here would be orient collapsing into pattern-matching.

value: THE POLARITY OF THE TWO STAMPED PLACES IS UNDECLARED, and there are two in the house pointing opposite ways. cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py source_fingerprint + standing(): MATCH = the seal still holds, MISMATCH voids the green — Akien's polarity. cairn/machines/ruling/ruling.py conforms_fingerprint + verify(): MATCH is the FAILURE ('UNTOUCHED: <file> is byte-identical to intake'), because a file that must change to conform and hasn't means the ruling never landed. The pair must SAY which question its stamp answers — 'what I judged' (match = still true) or 'what must change' (match = not yet done) — or a reader cannot tell a stale pair from a satisfied one.

ARE THE SIX ONE KIND OR TWO? Five judge a CROSSING (entry, exit, emission, clearance, ticket-required — all inline in transitions.py); build_inspector judges a COMPONENT. If that is two kinds wearing one word, 'one class for all gates' is the wrong shape and this cast splits. Deliberately NOT settled from the map; it is survey's question.

IS 'ticket-required' (:558) A GATE AT ALL, or a precondition? And the clearance seat is spread across :674-760 rather than sitting in one function, so 'six gates' is itself a claim the survey must check.

THE FINDING SHAPE HAS NO DECLARATION ANYWHERE TODAY. 'What the findings must contain' is the second of Akien's two places and does not exist in any form — build_inspector's finding shape is implicit in its code. A build piece against a measured absence.

HOW CHEAP CAN INSTALLATION BE? A living dial is legal only as an installed, versioned revision, with every finding recording WHICH revision judged it. If installation cannot be made cheap, the learning stays theoretical and this reduces to config-with-extra-steps — wrong-intent (b).

cairn/machines/build_inspector/intention+why.json — record that it becomes the FIRST TENANT of a general gate class rather than the owner of its gate, the same relation ruling 2026-08-07 recorded for the nest. Its hardware-verdict constraint does not move; it is LIFTED, and becomes the general class's constraint.

cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json — the gate class and its probe berth land under base's charter by the nest.py/probe.py precedent (block-general machinery lives in cairn.tools.base until a real need base cannot serve arrives).

cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json — record what a gate hands it and, more importantly, what it may NOT do with it: the notification is an INDEX; the crossing stays in the boat's own history. Wrong-intent (d) written into the charter it constrains.
Any charter write pokes cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh in the SAME act.

2026-08-10-clearance-is-mandatory (ruling, cast-but-unbuilt) and clearance-leaves-a-trace — both change what the CLEARANCE gate DOES; this ticket changes what a gate IS. Not exclusive. Sequencing is an open question: making clearance mandatory inside this work or before it.

The receiver-pull (Akien's 2026-08-11 ruling: kill the postman; a shim asks bus.undelivered(to=self.device_id) for its own mail) — NOT a child, a DEPENDENCY. Child a-gate-tells-the-harbor-master cannot be proved until it lands. Not yet cast.
banding-berths-at-the-general-level — LANDED. Its output (cairn/tools/base/nest.py) is what this ticket composes rather than rebuilds.

value.effect_on_this_cast: The sieve seed files carry NO order numeric — not in the filename, not as an in-band tiebreak, not anywhere. Order is the BAND, derived from the sieve's own reach, and there is no second way to say it. Akien's own '[optional order]' in his naming suggestion was withdrawn by him in the same breath; what he killed second was CC's counter-proposal to keep both. cairn/tools/base/nest.py had been enforcing this in its docstring for four days: 'ONLY the bands are ordered, and nothing here invents an order inside one.'
